summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all five fasting paragraphs and eleven parable paragraphs of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the fasting negations, ethical conditions, conditional freedom, additional vineyard work, shared inheritance, food distribution, intercession, and final approval. The notes distinguish working readings, editorial supplements, conjectures, reported variants, and physical losses without silently harmonizing witnesses. Servant terminology follows current policy. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied working source and consistency with the attributed evidence reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify an exhaustive collation. No replacement wording is proposed.
